mod_hidden_desc: Reveals all hidden tanks in the research tree.
mod_autoranks_desc: Disables rank locks in the hangar UI.
help_hidden_body:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Reveals ALL hidden tanks in the research tree (premium, collectible, test, deprecated). Purchase still depends on developers' offers — the mod only shows the vehicles.

MODIFIED FILES (relative to Data/):
• Configs/TechTree/*_tree.yaml (9 nations)
• XML/item_defs/vehicles/*/list.xml (9 nations)
In DLC (packs/): same paths with .dvpl extension — always DVPL.

IMPACT:
• Only research tree + vehicle lists (notInShop=false, tag cleanup deprecated/secret/testTank, new position entries).
• Does not touch balance, prices, hangar.

DLC:
• If packs contains a micro-update with new tanks, enable “Modify DLC”, otherwise update tanks stay hidden.
help_autoranks_body:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Removes rank gating from the UI: Battle button always visible, rank-unlock hints hidden, rank-up events removed.

MODIFIED FILES (relative to Data/):
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/Hangar.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/Squad/SquadView.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Inventory/Inventory.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Inventory/TankProgress/AchievementsTab.yaml
In DLC (packs/): same paths with .dvpl extension — always DVPL.

HOW IT EDITS (1:1 with the reference mod):
• Header # AutoRankOFF / # Generated: Huntez_GenMods.
• bindings ["visible", "not rankUnlockRequired"] → ["visible", ""].
• "not rankUnlockRequired and " cut out of conditions.
• The "rankUnlockRequired": "rankUnlockRequired" passthrough and the SquadView local param are deleted.
• UnlockRank and OnPromoRankInfoClicked removed from events.
• UnlockRank/UnlockFirstRank/FirstRankSoundPlayed/OnPromoRankInfoClicked elements cut out of eventActions (emptied items and blocks removed).
• needsUnlock: not isNull(dossier.rankState) → isNull(dossier.rankState).
• ranksAvailable: not isNull(selectedTank) → isNull(selectedTank) (rank master switch — without it the “your tank has a rank” celebration pops up).

IMPACT:
• Lobby/hangar visuals only.
• Does not touch research tree, balance, or account progress.
